explication: CodeWeaver is a CLI that scans a chosen directory, filters paths, and produces a Markdown document containing a file tree and file contents. Its documented options also support included/excluded path logs, a prepended instruction, and clipboard copying. The sampled source is partial, so some internal calls and output wiring are not visible; those relationships are omitted or marked unverified.
